programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Woody's parents want him to move back home, but the regulars try to keep him.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam and Diane buy a house from a couple who have been there for forty years.
programme.sub-title: A House Is Not A Home

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: With Sam and Diane's wedding day approaching, big questions still loom.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam returns to Cheers after sailing around the world and wants his job back.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam accepts an offer from his friend, sportscaster Dave Richards.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Carla and Eddie battle superstitions when they decide to get married.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Carla and Eddie dismiss the unfortunate events that occurred before the wedding as just bad luck.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Frasier tells his friends about a recent argument with Lilith.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Norm agrees to paint Rebecca's office in return for running up his tab.

programme.title: South Park: Potes pour la vie
programme.desc: Kenny obtient une PSP, mais il meurt. En réalité, Dieu l'a choisi pour mener une lutte salutaire au paradis. Malheureusement, les docteurs réaniment Kenny, qui se retrouve dans un état végétatif.

programme.title: South Park: La fureur de perdre
programme.desc: Les enfants de South Park sont désespérés : leurs parents veulent absolument qu'ils jouent au baseball mais eux s'ennuient terriblement. Tout empire lorsqu'ils apprennent qu'un match de qualification les obligerait à jouer tout l'été.

programme.title: South Park: La Mort d'Eric Cartman
programme.desc: Les enfants se mettent d'accord pour ignorer Cartman, et ce dernier croit qu'il est mort. Butters, qui n'est pas au courant de la supercherie, devient le médium de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: Le jour des érections
programme.desc: Jimmy a des problèmes d'érections impromptues. Étant donné qu'il doit participer au concours de talents, il cherche de l'aide pour résoudre ce problème.

programme.title: South Park: Marjorine
programme.desc: Butters maquille sa mort pour que les garçons puissent récupérer un appareil à faire des prédictions.

programme.title: South Park: Suivez cet œuf
programme.desc: Madame Garrison a encore des sentiments pour Monsieur Esclave, mais en allant le voir elle s'aperçoit qu'il est avec Al Super Gay et qu'ils comptent se marier.

programme.title: South Park: Les Rouquins
programme.desc: Cartman fait un exposé raciste sur les roux. Pour lui donner une leçon, Stan, Kyle et Kenny le teignent en roux dans son sommeil. Mais Cartman s'adapte à la situation en créant une ligue qui clame la supériorité des roux.

programme.title: South Park: Piégé dans le placard
programme.desc: Stan est endoctriné par l'Église de Scientologie avant de découvrir qu'il ne s'agit que d'une vaste machination.

programme.title: South Park: Sauvez Wilzy-X
programme.desc: Les enfants mettent tout en œuvre pour sauver Wilzy-X, une orque du bassin, et pour tenter de réaliser son rêve d'aller sur la lune. Ils ne réalisent pas qu'ils sont victimes d'un canular.

programme.title: South Park: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: Le père de Stan est alcoolique. Le petit garçon tente d'aider son père, d'autant que celui-ci est très mal conseillé par les Alcooliques Anonymes.

programme.title: South Park: Le Retour de Chef
programme.desc: Chef est de retour à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Danger Snobfog
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park achètent des voitures hybrides. Toutefois, alors que les habitants commencent à se sentir mieux parce qu'ils sauvent la planète, une masse noire orageuse recouvre la ville.

programme.title: South Park: Un million de petites fibres
programme.desc: Towelie écrit un livre qui est sélectionné par le club de lecture d'Oprah. Il devient un best-seller et se destine aux gens cherchant à dépasser leurs dépendances.

programme.title: South Park: Homoursporc
programme.desc: Les enfants essaient d'aider l'ancien vice-président Al Gore à se faire entendre par la population mais ils se retrouvent coincés dans une grotte. Alors qu'ils essaient d'en sortir, Cartman découvre un trésor.

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: La mère d'Éric n'a aucun contrôle sur son fils. Elle fait alors appel à plusieurs Nounou mais chacune échoue à leur mission. Un dresseur de chien prend alors la relève pour dompter Éric.

programme.title: South Park: Make Love, Not Warcraft
programme.desc: Les garçons jouent à World of Warcraft pendant tout le week-end lorsqu'un méchant joueur les tue sans aucun remord.

programme.title: South Park: Le Mystère du caca dans l'urinoir
programme.desc: Cartman croit savoir qui est à l'origine des attaques du 11 septembre.
programme.sub-title: Le Mystère du caca dans l'urinoir

programme.title: South Park: La Maitresse de Ike
programme.desc: C'est au tour de Cartman d'être le surveillant des couloirs, il profite de l'autorité qui lui est confié pour faire régner l'ordre sévèrement. Pendant ce temps, Ike tombe amoureux de sa maîtresse et ils ont une relation ensemble.

programme.title: South Park: L'Enfer sur Terre
programme.desc: Satan organise une énorme fête pour petite gamine pourrie gâtée pendant que les enfants de South Park tentent d'invoquer le rappeur Biggie Small en prononçant trois fois son nom devant un miroir.

programme.title: South Park: Vas-y Dieu, Vas-y Dieu (1/2)
programme.desc: Éric ne supporte plus d'attendre la sortie de la Nintendo Wii et ne veut pas endurer trois semaines de patience supplémentaire. Il décide alors de se congeler pour se réveiller le jour de la sortie de la Wii.

programme.title: South Park: Vas-y Dieu, Vas-y Dieu (2/2)
programme.desc: Toujours 500 ans dans le futur, Cartman est mêlé à la guerre mais ils est plus préoccupé à trouver un moyen de jouer à la Wii. Cela étant impossible dans le futur, il cherche une façon de retourner à son époque.

programme.title: South Park: La Coupe Stanley
programme.desc: Stan entraîne l'équipe poussins de hockey et essaie d'en faire des gagnants.

programme.title: South Park: Avec nos excuses à Jesse Jackson
programme.desc: Randy Marsh dit le mot « nègre » à la télévision nationale et devient la risée du pays ; Cartman se moque d'un nain et se bat contre lui.
programme.sub-title: Avec nos excuses à Jesse Jackson

programme.title: South Park: La Photo
programme.desc: Cartman veut faire croire que Butters est gay, mais lorsque le père de ce dernier s'en aperçoit, il envoie Butters dans un camp de rééducation.

programme.title: South Park: Les Poux
programme.desc: Une infection de poux atteint l'école primaire de South Park. Alors que Madame Garrison refuse de donner des noms, Cartman trouve un moyen de savoir qui a des poux et ainsi de se moquer des enfants atteints.

programme.title: South Park: Chattomique
programme.desc: Un nouvel élève arrive a South Park : un jeune arabe. Cartman pense alors qu'un attentat se prépare. Grâce à Kyle, branché sur Internet, ils remontent la piste d'un attentat imminent sur Hillary Clinton en visite à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Le Fantastique Mystère de Pâques
programme.desc: Stan se demande pourquoi on doit peindre des œufs le jour de Pâques. Il ne s'attendait pas à découvrir un secret aussi énorme.

programme.title: South Park: G-Win!
programme.desc: Madame Garrison se fait plaquer pour la dernière fois. Elle compte bien passer toute sa colère sur sa classe de CM1.

programme.title: South Park: La Nuit des clochards-vivants
programme.desc: La ville doit faire face à une recrudescence des SDF. Les enfants vont essayer de régler ce problème épineux.

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Cartman prétend avoir le syndrome Gilles de la Tourette pour pouvoir dire des choses affreuses en direct à la télévision.

programme.title: South Park: Gros Caca
programme.desc: Randy est constipé. Il prend alors des laxatifs pour aller déféquer. Après quelques instants de terribles douleurs sur le trône, Randy s'apprête à tirer la chasse mais il remarque que son caca est démesurément grand.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 1
programme.desc: Eric assure avoir aperçu un leprechaun dans la forêt, mais Kyle ne le croit pas. Ils font un pari ensemble : si Cartman prouve l'existence du leprechaun, Kyle devra lui sucer les boules sinon il devra donner 10$ à Kyle.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 2
programme.desc: Les pires créatures ont été libérées par les terroristes et dévastent Imaginationland, où Butters est toujours piégé. Le gouvernement réquisitionne Stan et Kyle afin de trouver un moyen d'entrer à Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 3
programme.desc: Suite à l'accident du portail, Stan est entré dans Imaginationland où Butters est considéré par les créatures imaginaires comme un élu capable de sauver Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Zéro
programme.desc: Stan et Kyle sont accros au jeu Guitar Hero. Mais Stan est meilleur que Kyle, et leur amitié semble s'en dégrader.

programme.title: South Park: La Liste
programme.desc: Les filles ont une liste des garçons les plus beaux de la classe. Clyde est premier, mais à sa grande déception Kyle est dernier.

programme.title: South Park: Amygdales
programme.desc: Cartman se retrouve à devoir lutter pour sa vie lorsqu'une banale opération des amygdales tourne mal.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro, Kin'emon, and Luffy are reunited again, but little do they know that their reunion is being monitored by a potential threat! Meanwhile, the battle rages on between Doflamingo and Law as these two powerhouses clash.
programme.sub-title: A Showdown Between the Warlords! Law vs. Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro and Kin'emon make a mad dash to save Law but Navy Admiral Fujitora stands in their way, bringing his full power against them. The Navy is in hot pursuit as a ship approaches with unexpected visitors from the past.
programme.sub-title: Two Great Rivals Meet Each Other! Straw Hat and Heavenly Demon!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After revealing the horrible history of Dressrosa, Toy Soldier now shares their plan to liberate the Tontatta Kingdom and bring down the Doflamingo Family, Operation SOP. Luffy bumps into a heavily-wounded Bellamy and Bartolomeo
programme.sub-title: Luffy Astonished! The Man Who Inherits Ace's Will!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp and Robin make their way via an underground tunnel dug by the tiny people of the Tontatta Tribe - a tunnel so small in fact, that Franky couldn't fit! Instead, Franky makes his way to the Toy House.
programme.sub-title: Operation SOP Starts! Usoland Charges Forth!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As the contenders for the battle of Block D dwindle to only thirty, Rebecca has her hands full with the menacing Suleiman the Beheader! All hope seems lost that she can take him down and move on to the finals!
programme.sub-title: A Burning Passion! Rebecca vs. Suleiman!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The battle for Block D comes to a shocking end and the winner that emerges from the cloud of dust stuns the audience even more! Meanwhile, Luffy, Zoro, Kin'emon, and Wicka of the Tontatta Tribe are about to reach the lift to the palace.
programme.sub-title: The End of the Match?! A Surprising Result of Block D!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Viola, aka Violet, once a great princess of the Dressrosa family, shows Luffy & the others a secret entrance into the palace which avoids the use of the heavily-guarded lift. In the palace's Suit Chamber, Navy Admiral Fujitora reveals his plans.
programme.sub-title: The Admiral's Decision! Fujitora vs. Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The final round at the Corrida Colosseum finally begins, as Diamante joins the combatants in an all-out struggle to win the Flare-Flare Fruit! As the stakes escalate, can one champion beat the others & snatch the fruit from the Colosseum's newest hazard?
programme.sub-title: The Final Round Starts! Diamante the Hero Shows Up!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his group continue their ascent towards Doflamingo's inner sanctum, but standing in their way is an executive of the family whose power is so strong moving past him seems impossible! Meanwhile, Cavendish learns the dark secrets of Dressrosa.
programme.sub-title: A Moving Castle! The Top Executive Pica Rises Up!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As Operation SOP finally gets underway but as Leo makes the dash to hide the Tatabasco grape in Sugar's fruit basket, Robin calls for an emergency stop to the plan! Meanwhile, Luffy, Violet, and Zoro are stalled by Pica whose sheer size overwhelms them.
programme.sub-title: Dragon Claw Strikes! Lucy's Intimidating Attack!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Operation SOP is underway and nearing its final stage! But Trebol proves a far stronger guard for Sugar than was expected, so Robin hatches a plan to lure him away. But is there enough time to execute the plan before the ruse is discovered?
programme.sub-title: Defeat Sugar! The Army of the Little People Charges!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Tontattas are devastated by Trebol's furious attack, but as Usopp tries to convince Leo to abort the operation, Leo tells him about their commander Toy Soldier's stunning true identity! The Toy Soldier finally shakes off Lao G and gets moving again!
programme.sub-title: The Last Light of Hope! The Secret of Our Commander!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro continues his deadly duel with the nearly indestructible Pica! While the Toy Soldier narrowly escapes Lao G only to come face to face with Gladius! Luffy continues his mad dash to the top of the palace to face Doflamingo!
programme.sub-title: The Rupture Human! Gladius Blows Up Big Time!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With the Tontattas beaten, Robin turned into a toy, and Luffy, Franky, and the others busy elsewhere, Usopp is the last hope for Operation SOP! But will he be able to muster the confidence and courage to face the terrible Trebol?
programme.sub-title: A Liar! Usoland on the Run!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp runs into trouble in his battle with Treebol, and flashback sheds light on how a young Kyros made the shocking transition from murderer to one of King Riku's most trusted men.
programme.sub-title: A Fateful Encounter! Kyros and King Riku!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: In the Royal Palace, Viola, Luffy, and the Toy Soldier have hidden themselves outside Doflamingo's chamber, only to have more enemies approach from behind, leaving them surrounded! Meanwhile, Franky is knocked out cold by the Navy.
programme.sub-title: The Operation Failed! Usoland the Hero Dies?!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Toys all across Dressrosa regain their human form, a flood of forgotten memories return, and Kyros launches a long overdue attack on the villainous tyrant Doflamingo!
programme.sub-title: The Legend is Back! Kyros' All-out Blow!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Kyros finally taking down Doflamingo leaves Doflamingo's clan shocked! Meanwhile at the Colosseum, Rebecca gets her memories of her loving father Kyros back, and Sabo makes a move to end the championship battle by blowing up the whole ring!
programme.sub-title: The Fire Fist Strikes! The Flare-Flare Fruit Power Returns!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy hurries to free Law, but with their pirate alliance dissolved, will Law still see Luffy as an ally? Meanwhile, Usopp has convinced his newfound followers to destroy the factory! Doflamingo's defeat has thrown Dressrosa into chaos.
programme.sub-title: Dashing onto the Scene! The Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army - Sabo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The mystery of Doflamingo's return from the dead is revealed! But there isn't much time to ponder how it happened, as his plan to silence the country of Dressrosa unfolds, spelling doom for the Straw Hats!
programme.sub-title: The Devil's Trap! A Dressrosa Extermination Plan!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As the people of Dressrosa see their friends and loved ones slaughter each other under the manipulation of Doflamingo, memories of 10 years ago rush back, and the truth of that event becomes clear. Doflamingo announces the rules for his deadly game.
programme.sub-title: The 500 Million Berry Man! Target: Usoland!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Doflamingo and Fujitora's agreement to not engage each other lasts for the moment - meaning all eyes are turned towards taking down the Straw Hats and claiming the rewards! And as Luffy starts heading to the Royal Palace, Fujitora stands in his way!
programme.sub-title: Breaking through Enemy Lines! Luffy and Zoro Launch the Counter-Attack!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Robin, Usopp, the Tontattas and the others make moves to rejoin Luffy as Doflamingo's deadly game rages on! Meanwhile, Kin'emon makes it to the trash heap in his search for his friend Kanjuro - just as Pica emerges in the town.
programme.sub-title: With a Rumbling of the Ground! The God of Destruction - Giant Pica Descends!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With Luffy & the others recovering from Pica's attack, the game is afoot! Luffy has just enough time to regroup and set out to find Doflamingo, only to find that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! A strange argument breaks out.
programme.sub-title: Gathering into a Powerful Front! Luffy and a Group of Brutal Warriors!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Don Chin Jao and Elizabello successfully break Pica's giant arm but the rock giant is unfazed and starts throwing even more destructive punches at Luffy and his band of unwanted collaborators! Meanwhile, Navy Admiral Fujitora moves into action.
programme.sub-title: Steady Progress! Luffy’s Army vs. Pica!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Moocy fast approach the showdown with Doflamingo - while the others with a beef against him continue to tag along. Meanwhile, Violet finds the key to Law's handcuffs, and Rebecca pledges to deliver it to him.
programme.sub-title: A Shocking Confession! Law's Soulful Vow!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy makes headway toward Doflamingo's refuge, making his way through Doflamingo's guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who has the power of the Fire Fist from eating the Flare-Flare Fruit!
programme.sub-title: A Big Collision! Chief of Staff - Sabo vs. Admiral Fujitora!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy cuts a lucky break as Kelly Funk shows him a shortcut to the Palace! But all may not be as it seems... Meanwhile, Franky and Zoro are locked in one-on-one duels, while Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo enlist the help of the Tontattas.
programme.sub-title: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Gets Caught in a Trap!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Penned in at the bottom of a well, Luffy and Law are caught in a trap! But someone has come to save them who they least expect! Meanwhile, the Tontattas help Franky break in to the SMILE factory, and Bartolomeo resorts to tactics he used in the Colosseum.
programme.sub-title: A Great Escape! Luffy's Tide-turning Elephant Gun!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Tontattas locate their captive comrades and seem to be able to get the message to them - the prison break is on! Meanwhile, heavy-hitters from the Colosseum turn from wringing each other's necks towards a unified plan.
programme.sub-title: A United Front! Luffy's Breakthrough to the Victory!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Hidden far underground, Kin'emon finds his old friend Kanjuro whose powers allow the two to, quickly, but not elegantly, escape to the surface! Meanwhile, Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along.
programme.sub-title: The Second Samurai! Evening Shower Kanjuro Appears!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Tontattas are in full revolt! But can they keep their wits about them long enough to make it out? Meanwhile, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Señor Pink.
programme.sub-title: A Hard-Fought Battle Against Pica! Zoro's Deadly Attack!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Franky finally makes it into the factory and the Tontattas are reunited with their captive friends! But Princess Mansherry is nowhere to be found. Factory manager Kuween becomes irate when ignored and launches an attack on Franky.
programme.sub-title: The Little People's Princess! Captive Mansherry!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo draw closer to the Flower Field on the fourth level of the Royal Palace plateau, but a sudden attack by Gladius' exploding spheres sends Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling towards the level below.
programme.sub-title: Invincible! A Gruesome Army of Headcracker Dolls!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves the Crystal Kingdom: Dora and Boots travel into a storybook to help their new friend Allie save the Crystal Kingdom. And they need your help! A Greedy King has taken all of the crystals that make the kingdom colorful.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves The Mermaids: It's Clean-Up the Beach Day, as Dora and Boots are cleaning up garbage when they find a Singing Clam, who tells them the story of Mariana the Mermaid. Mariana lives in the Mermaid Kingdom at the bottom of the ocean.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's World Adventure: All over the world, everyone's celebrating Friendship Day! But when Swiper mistakenly swipes all the special glowing Friendship Bracelets, Dora needs to team up with him to bring them back to the Friendship Parades.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Dance to the Rescue: Put on your dancing shoes, because Dora needs you to spin, shake wiggle, jump and clap with her as she tries to rescue Swiper the fox, who's been trapped inside a bottle by a mean dancing elf.
programme.sub-title: Dora's Dance to the Rescue - HOUR SPECIAL

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Fairytale Adventure: Dora and Boots are exploring in the forest when they discover the gate to Fairy-Tale Land and enter this magical place. But...there's a mean witch who lives in Fairy-Tale Land.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Pirate Adventure: Yo ho ho! Dora and Boots and all their friends are putting on a pirate show today for their mommies and daddies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Lost and Found: Dora and Boots find a little baby blue bird who fell out of her nest.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Hic-Boom-Ohhh: What's that funny sound coming from Yellow Valley? Dora and Boots set off to investigate. They'll have to go across the Noisy River, then tiptoe through the Quiet Forest, and that's how they'll get to Yellow Valley to find the sound.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Ice Cream: Deedle dee dee! Dora and Boots hear the ice cream truck nearby, but they just miss it.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Choo Choo: All aboard! It's time for the big train race. First train to the Big Yellow Station wins a big whistle.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Treasure Island: Dora and Boots find a blue key; it turns out it's the key to a big treasure chest.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Three L'il Piggies: Dora and Boots are at the farm today, bringing presents to the three little piggies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Big River: Boots loses one of his shiny red boots in the Big River. Dora and Boots set off on a wild water adventure as they chase the runaway boot.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Berry Hunt: Dora and Boots go hunting for blueberries on Blueberry Hill. But they'll have to be careful--Swiper the fox lives on Blueberry Hill!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: WizzleWishes: Dora and Boots meet Wizzle who lost his bag of wishes and can't get home. Our heroes, Dora and Boots, set off in search of the lost wishes.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Grandma's House: Dora and Boots set off to deliver a basket of treats to Dora's Abuela to help her cold. Dora's mother warns her to watch out for Swiper the Fox. He'll swipe the treats.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Surprise: It's Boots' birthday! Dora tells him that all his friends are waiting at her house to give Boots a big party.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Sticky Tape: Benny the Bull needs some Sticky Tape in a hurry. His hot air balloon is leaking, and floating toward Crocodile Lake! Dora and Boots rush off to rescue their friend.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Bouncing Ball: Boots buys a super blue bouncy ball at the store, but it bounces off down the hill.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Backpack: Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the Library. Can they reach the Library before it closes?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Bugga Bugga: Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Fish Out of Water: Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Little Star: Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves the Prince: Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Red Chicken: Dora and Boots read about a chicken that's as big as a house and set off on an educational adventure to meet him.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: El Coqui: In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Stuck Truck: Calling all trucks! Boots sure loves trucks. When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue. Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Louder!: What are we going to do? Cockledoodledoo! Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun. Along the way we practice making lots of noise.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Roberto The Robot: Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Potato: Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Journey To The Purple Planet: Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Invasion of the Body Jacker: Jammerhead takes identity theft to whole new level when he gets his hands on the ultimate stealth device—The Bodyjacker! He uses it to take over Darius Dun's body!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Freaks Come Out at Night: After an outing downtown, Mikey starts behaving strangely -- as in super strength, green-slime-spewing strangely. The reason, the Turtles soon discover, is that Mikey has been "implanted" by one of Sh'Okanabo's "gene-seeds".

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Bad Blood: There are some new terrapins in town - the Dark Turtles: the psychotic clones of the original TMNT. They can match the boys kick for kick (or in Mikey's case, quip for quip).

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Journal: While rooting around in Cody's Trophy Room, Don, Leo, Mike and Raph come across the old "future history" journal kept by April O'Neil and Casey Jones.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Gaminator: The Turtles get their hands on a prototype game system called "The Gaminator," rumored to be the ultimate gaming experience. They get more than they bargained for when they are digitized and sucked into the game.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Graduation Day: Class of 2105: Splinter is pleased to announce that the Turtles are about to graduate from the ninja rank of Genin to the more advanced rank of Chunin.Everyone is excited until it is made clear that Michelangelo will not be graduating!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Timing is Everything: When Darius Dun and Sh'Okanabo join forces, it can only mean one thing—trouble! Anxious to test out their version of Cody's Time Window, Sh'Okanabo jumps the gun and unleashes a "Time storm" on NYC!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Enter the Jammerhead: Jammerhead busts his way out of prison, looking to even the score with his Turtle Nemeses. Thanks to a newly developed chip, he can download fighter footage) and instantly mimic the moves.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Milk Run: Intergalactic mercenary TORBIN ZIIXX returns and enlists the Turtles' help in smuggling a ship full of humanitarian aid past TRICERATON GANGSTERS. But the Triceratons are obsessed with finding Ziixx.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Fall of Darius Dunn: When Cody uncovers Darius Dunn's secret weapons manufacturing program, he and his uncle have a final showdown over who will ultimately control the vast O'Neil tech empire.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtle X-Tinction: Turtle X is on the rampage throughout New Manhattan - but Cody insists he has nothing to do with it. It turns out the fugitive Darius Dun planted a "Trojan Horse" virus in Cody's exo-armor and is now controlling Turtle X.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Race for Glory: The Turtles enter a tricked-out Hovershell in a cross-country road race that pits the latest high tech experimental vehicles against one another.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Head of State: When President Bishop is attacked by mysterious underground monsters, he enlists the help of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. Our fearless green guardians must rescue Bishop before he loses his head to a figure from the Turtles' past.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: DNA is Thicker than Water: Darius comes down hard on the Darks and places the blame squarely on Dark Leo's spiky shoulders. To prove that he is an apt leader Dark Leo devises a plan to destroy the Turtles from within.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Cosmic Completist: Raphael has contempt for Michelangelo's geeky toy collection, but when the leader of the Inawashi Gunjin comes to the Turtles for help with a malevolent alien, Raphael must think like a geek to beat Aramzedo, the ultimate collector!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Day of Awakening: When the entire population of Moonbase Bishop goes missing, it appears that Sh'Okanabo has jump started his plan to take over the Earth.The Turtles stage an assault on the base, only to find a bigger, badder Sh'Okanabo!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Zixxth Sense: Torbin Zixx convinces the Turtles to help him recover an experimental matter transmitter that he was forced to give to Boss Zukko to pay off a debt. The fate of the world may rest on the success of their mission. But can they trust Zixx?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Tempus Fugit: When the Time Window is finally repaired, the Turtles enter into it to head home, but instead of finding themselves back in the lair, our heroes find themselves with Viral!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Karate Schooled: When the turtles are reunited with Casey and April, it's smiles all around … until it becomes clear that Casey's being brainwashed by his new martial arts instructor, Master Khan, a devoted Foot operative.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Something Wicked: The turtles' journey into cyberspace as Cybernauts on a mission to save as much of Master Splinter as they can find. But, they find far more than they're ready for. The Shredder! Born again. Inside the digital realm.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Engagement Ring: Casey and Raph head to Chinatown to find an engagement ring for April. They find one, all right. Too bad it has dark, transformational powers. Powers that are of interest to Hun and the Purple Dragons as well…

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Hacking Stockman: While Don focuses on collecting Splinter's data bits, his brothers find themselves pulled into a war between The Foot and the Purple Dragons. But things get a lot worse when the cyber-Shredder finds a way out of the digital realm!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Incredible Shrinking Serling: Desperate to get back to his own time, Serling builds a makeshift Time Window for himself. But when he's zapped to the NYC sewers to Turtle Tot time it's his worst nightmare as they tap him as their favorite new toy.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Identity Crisis: Cyber Shredder unleashes a virus that wipes the turtles memories out... reprogramming them so that they work for the Foot! The turtles do the bidding of Master Khan while April, Casey and Serling must work together to save our heroes.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Web Wranglers: When the Cyber Shredder creates a web portal that will allow him to venture from cyberspace into the real world, he first tests the device by releasing all sorts of mutants and monsters from various online programs.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: SuperQuest: The good news is the Turtles have found more of Splinter's lost data bits! The bad news is they're imbedded within the interface of Mikey's favorite online video game, SuperQuest!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Virtual Reality Check: The turtles leave Cyberspace to find everything very … normal. But, as this normalcy starts to unravel, the turtles realize they're still in Cyberspace, and the Shredder is tricking them.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: City Under Siege: With the Foot reassembled and his powers greater than ever, the Shredder hacks into the NYC computer grid and brings the city to its knees! The Turtles take to the rooftops to stop him!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Is The Brain a snob? That seems to be the explanation for why he won't go to Waterworld with his friends. And, Arthur's a notorious joke-killer. But when he's scheduled to perform as a carnival clown, he learns how to make people laugh!
programme.sub-title: Water and The Brain/Arthur The Unfunny

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Poor Sue Ellen has lost the one thing she's never without--her diary. Then, Arthur's hurt his knee but won't tell Mom--because then she'd know he'd been playing down at the dump , where he was NOT allowed to go.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and D.W. are planning a surprise party for Grandma Thora. But amidst the party-planning mayhem, they forget about the guest of honor! Then, shy Fern hosts a slumber party at her mother's urging.
programme.sub-title: Grandma Thora Appreciation Day/Fern's Slumber Party

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Muffy tries to bribe the judges at the school science fair, Francine and The Brain plot revenge. And D.W., a newly-deputized Junior Safety Officer, has a reputation for being a strict enforcer of the rules--well, OK, a tattle-tale.
programme.sub-title: Love Notes For Muffy/D.W. Blows The Whistle

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Francine and Catherine are very different, but it’s no fun if you're two sisters sharing the same room. Then, there's only one thing in life Arthur really wants—to win! But he just can't stop losing. Is it really so wrong to cheat a little?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and The Brain encounter a new crossing guard on the way home from school. This guard isn't just mean, he's nuts! And, D.W. is making Arthur's life miserable! Francine decides she'd fix D.W.'s behavior before Arthur loses his mind.
programme.sub-title: Arthur vs. The Very Mean Crossing Guard/D.W.'s Very Bad Mood

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. and Arthur get their feelings hurt when their efforts to insult each other get out of control. Next, Arthur, Brain, and Binky find a key--but to what? And which of them will get to keep whatever fabulous thing they find with it?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What's a budding entrepreneur to do when her homemade cookies hit the big time? Especially when the recipe isn't really hers? Then, Arthur and Francine would love to lend their sisters to Sue Ellen, who's sick of being an only child.
programme.sub-title: How The Cookie Crumbles/Sue Ellen's Littler Sister

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buster's coming home! The word spreads fast, but so does the fear that Buster will be different. Then, it seems to Buster, not only have his friends changed while he was gone, but they've forgotten all about him! Will he ever fit in again?
programme.sub-title: Buster's Back/The Ballad Of Buster Baxter

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Ms. Morgan announces they'll be having a fire drill during preschool, D.W. wants no part of it--it sounds way too scary. Then, the Tibble Twins are better than D.W. at just about everything.
programme.sub-title: D.W., All Fired Up/I'd Rather Read It Myself

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Since they rescued Wilbur Rabbit, Arthur and Muffy have been inseparable. But the rest of their friends are growing tired of the new Arthur. And, Brain's a great partner for a school assignment--unless you wanted to work on it, too!
programme.sub-title: Arthur Goes Crosswire/Sue Ellen And The Brainasaurous

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Wouldn't it be cool to find out that your ancestors were famous frontier explorers? But what if they were just...plain folks? The Magic Toolbox show is coming to Ratburn's class to put the kids on TV!
programme.sub-title: Background Blues/And Now Let's Talk To Some Kids

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What a mysterious, beautiful thing a green potato chip is--and D.W. just ate a gigantic one! But then she hears a rumor that they're poisonous...Sure, kids do some pretty embarrassing things, but do Moms have to tell everyone?
programme.sub-title: The Chips Are Down/Revenge Of The Chip

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Writing your own name in graffiti all over the school wouldn't be very smart, right? Binky says he didn't do it, so detectives Fern and Buster are on the case. Then, Binky is the newest, hottest, hippest pop music craze in Elwood City.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Woogles have their own names and personalities and they're so darned cute! And Arthur's gotta have one, especially now that everyone is collecting them. Arthur wouldn't mind if Dad's infamous dessert "experiments" remained a family secret.
programme.sub-title: Arthur Rides The Bandwagon/Dad's Dessert Dilemma

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Sue Ellen and Fern take a popularity quiz in a magazine and change their personalities to become more likable, but it backfires. And Buster's convinced that his great joke will be the difference between a successful oral report and failure.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Buster digs up an ancient arrowhead, everyone else wants to hunt for buried treasures, too. And a field trip to the Medieval Fair pits Arthur's class against another led by Ratburn's super-tough mentor, Mr. Pryce-Jones.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Treasure Hunt/The Return Of The King

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: If you think the Tibbles are bad now, imagine what they'd be like if they had super powers! Then, D.W. needs money, quick. When she tries to pull a fast one on the Tooth Fairy, will Arthur have to pay?
programme.sub-title: Attack Of The Turbo Tibbles/D.W. Tricks The Tooth Fairy

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Playing with the Tibble twins requires preparation, endurance and earplugs. But when one gets sick, playing with the other should be a lot easier, right? Arthur and the gang create their own music videos.
programme.sub-title: Double Tibble Trouble/Arthur's Almost Live Not Real Music Festival

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Sue Ellen's not afraid of much, but when she encounters a really creepy howling noise in the woods, she's scared for real. Then, Grandma Thora has a lot of fun stuff, especially her porcelain doll, Clarissa.
programme.sub-title: What Scared Sue Ellen?/Clarissa Is Cracked

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When painfully shy George brings a ventriloquist dummy to school, a popular kid is born! Then, Arthur thinks the best pet to have is a dog, and Francine probably would have agreed--that is, until little Nemo, a cute kitten, came along.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Dummy Disaster/Francine and The Feline

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Mom and Dad fight over spilled milk, Arthur and D.W. fear the worst. Is it Arthur's fault or D.W.'s? Then, turning five is a major, big deal event! But D.W. worries that she fribbled away her preschool years on meaningless pursuits.
programme.sub-title: Mom and Dad Have A Great Big Fight/D.W.'s Perfect Wish

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur just might make it to Happy Crazy Wow Day at the park--if he and D.W. can work together to clean their rooms! Then, Arthur and the gang realize they are suffering from the January doldrums brought on by an acute lack of holidays.
programme.sub-title: Arthur and D.W. Clean Up/The Long, Dull Winter

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When D.W. discovers that she can get her own library card, she rejoices at the world of books waiting for her. And, is it ever okay to hit someone? Sometimes you just get so mad, you wanna....pow! Right??

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The kids capture a snake and learn that it's possibly poisonous--after it gets lost in Arthur's house! Why is Muffy interviewing for a new best friend? She and Francine are usually inseparable, but lately it seems they have less in common.
programme.sub-title: Hide And Snake/Muffy's New Best Friend

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Will Buster's friends treat him the same after they learn he has asthma? Prankster have arrived in Elwood City--just in time for the "Scare Your Pants Off" costume party! It's boys vs. girls in what becomes a great big battle of the pranks.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What would happen if Arthur and his friends entered a contest to write stories for their favorite TV show? Then, look out world, D.W. has discovered science! But D.W.'s new-found passion proves that a little knowledge is a dangerous thing.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A blizzard comes to town, taking out the electricity and sending residents scrambling for supplies. Can neighbors find ways to help each other survive through the storm? Then, the unthinkable is happening...Arthur's teacher is moving in!
programme.sub-title: The Blizzard/The Rat Who Came To Dinner

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What happens when you combine Greek Mythology with D.W.'s imagination? Then, getting two Polly Locket dolls almost ruins Prunella's birthday party. That, and Francine's bad mood--why, she wouldn't even sing the Happy Birthday song!
programme.sub-title: D.W. Tale Spins/Prunella Gets It Twice

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Does Binky have a favorite pastime? Not until citywide Bug Week, when suddenly all he can think about is butterflies. Then, there's a horrible racket in Elwood City, and it's Francine practicing her singing and drumming for the Talent Show!
programme.sub-title: Binky Barnes, Wingman/To Beat Or Not To Beat

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Buster insists that he will miss the Father's Day picnic because he has other plans, Arthur is convinced that he's really sad and embarrassed about his parents’ divorce. And Prunella predicts a gift of flashpants, the hot new fashion.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and friends are all faced with seemingly impossible tasks, from fixing a model biplane to babysitting D.W. And, Buster knows he's fun, but he's beginning to feel like he's not particularly good at anything.
programme.sub-title: What Is That Thing?/Buster's Best Behavior

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's the duel of the century as cellist Yo-Yo Ma faces jazz saxophonist Joshua Redman in the toughest gig of their careers at the Elwood City Library! Then, will Arthur be exposed as a baby show lover?
programme.sub-title: My Music Rules/That's A Baby Show!

programme.desc: Reluctantly forced together as roommates, two women (Ari Graynor, Lauren Anne Miller) find that their financial and domestic situation greatly improves when they team up to start a phone-sex line.

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Susan is in a bind after spilling food on Sta'abi and apologizing about it. Insulted, Sta'abi hunts Susan to feed her "fralnick" to Vornicarn.
programme.sub-title: The Sorry Syndrome/Speak Not the Q Word

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Strange secrets begin to unfold when Derek returns to expose our friends at Area Fifty Something. Monger is away for the weekend! This is great news for Team Monster and Team Alien until they're introduced to Rule-Bot.
programme.sub-title: It Came From Channel 5/It Ruled with an Iron Fist

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Link and Sta'abi duel for driving privileges of a new supercar. Sqweep wants to drive too though, and takes off on a supersonic joyride.
programme.sub-title: Driven to Madness/The Beast From 20,000 Gallons

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: With everyone down with alien flu, Coverton tries to steal base secrets, but fails to account for a huge gelatinous hallucinating B.O.B. Vornicarn's bad behavior lands him in the Isolation Zone.
programme.sub-title: The Sneezing Horror/Prisoner of the Dark Dimension

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: B.O.B. eats Dr. C's "probabilitator" and foresees Coverton with a crown, but soon Coverton discovers the painful truth about his future.

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Sqweep has to go "number seven". Team Monster fears the destruction it will cause and sets out to contain it! Link pursues Sta'abi using a pheromone spray of Sqweep's design that ends up having unforeseen consequences.
programme.sub-title: Number Seven!/The Friend Who Wasn't There

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Susan and Bob play detective when Dr. Cutter arrives to update the base's technology. Link and Bob find an old spaceship that they take on a joyride, but things go bad when Coverton spots them and alarms the base of a hostile alien invasion.
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Dr. Cutter/The Partymobile That Invaded Earth

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: After hacking into Monger's top secret files, the monsters learn that there was supposed to be another member of the team: The Man-Beast!
programme.sub-title: Curse of the Man-Beast/It Came From Level Z

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: A stray kitten makes its way onto the base and accidently obtains Susan's ginormica powers! Sta'abi recruits Bob to teach her the "Art of Combat", after she witnesses him winning Link's new video game.

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Monger gathers everyone for his favorite combat training exercise-a game of "no rules" dodge ball. Dr. Cockroach creates a special spray to give the President more authority.
programme.sub-title: This Ball Must Be Dodged/It Spoke With Authority

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: The monsters start borrowing from Sqweep's allowance, but their spending spree soon comes to a halt when another alien planet arrives. After Dr. C messes with Sqweep's Earth Studies project, the little alien receives a Zrub--the lowest possible grade.
programme.sub-title: Debtor Alive!/The Grade that Wouldn't Pass!

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Dr. Cockroach's new teleportation experiment goes bad when he accidently teleports the Diner into space!
programme.sub-title: You Can't Breathe in a Diner... In Space!/Race to the End...Zone!

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Susan has her ginormic hands full as she tries to escape the world wide web of an omniscient alien named... the Internet! Guest Star: Josh Gad
programme.sub-title: Bride of the Internet/The Invisible Threat! (Also Silent)

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Beware of little leprechaun aliens - you don't want to know what can happen when the happy dancing and singing stop. Something horrifying lurks in Coverton's chambers, soTeam Monster is forced to submit to actual memory wipes.
programme.sub-title: When Luck Runs Out/That Which Cannot Be Unseen

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tom and Karen say Madison, 15, is out of control. Tom has served seven tours of duty in the Middle East commanding troops but says he's faced his scariest and most dangerous enemy in his own home. Fearing for their lives, they need Dr. Phil’s help. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Police Called 100 Times On Our Car Stealing, Drug Taking, Dad Beating, Beautiful 15-Year-Old Daughter, Who Is Now Corrupting Her Younger Sister Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: For the past 2 years Nancy has been in an online relationship with "Shaun" she says is an honest and loving man. Her son Darcy says Nancy doesn't even know what he looks like! Nancy is adamant she is not being scammed in this catfish story of online love.
programme.sub-title: Talk To Dr. Phil Or We're Done Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Summer Wells, 5, vanished from her Tennessee home, June 15, 2021. Parents Don & Candus claim abduction; online bullies say the opposite. Don & Candus meet with Scott Rouse & Greg Hartley, body language experts who work with the FBI, police and military.
programme.sub-title: The Disappearance of Summer Wells Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a drug-abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he break down and take it?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Four adult siblings say they've been blacklisted by their mother from seeing their dying father, a claim their mother vehemently denies. Emotions run high when this fractured family comes together on Dr. Phil’s stage. Can they put an end to the fighting?
programme.sub-title: Blacklisted By Mom: Can We Speak To Our Dad Before He Dies

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Megan, her ex-boyfriend, Andy and his fiancee Caitlin, who have presented Dr. Phil with evidence supporting their allegation that it is Megan's own lifestyle & choices keeping her out of her son's life. Who is telling the truth?
programme.sub-title: A Father Accused, A Mother Blamed, The Truth Revealed Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How well do you know your teenager? Could your child be participating in risky or illegal activities right under your own roof?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How did 21-year-old Jenna go from being a straight-A UC Berkeley student and former beauty queen to abusing heroin and meth and used as sexual currency in a drug house? Her mom is desperate to save her only child and turns to Dr. Phil for intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pregnancy is a time of baby showers, nesting, indulging food cravings and being pampered. But Dr. Phil’s guests, Shayna, says she's been pregnant more than a year, and Zona, says she's been pregnant over 3 1/2 years, Both are looking for answers why.
programme.sub-title: A Woman Claims To Be Pregnant For 3 Years 7 Months

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mike and Vicki say their 37-year-old son, Ryan, once made millions running a successful real estate company, but for the past three months, he has been living in their garage with his 24-year-old girlfriend, Rachel. Dr. Phil asks Ryan tough questions.
programme.sub-title: Our Son Was Making Millions, But Is Now Living In Our Garage With His Girlfriend

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Brittany who says dad Charlie is being scammed by his online fiancée "Stephanie" & her roommate "Carina." Charlie hopes to get married when they meet in person. The real women in the photos are on stage & Charlie goes face-to-face!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can married people be friends with someone of the opposite sex without sex getting in the way? At what point does a friendly relationship become an affair of the heart or emotional infidelity? Meet Randy, who says his wife, Amanda, has crossed that line.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Katlynn, Zach & Amber say dad Todd prioritizes everything over them: job, wife & new family. They say their dad missed weekend visits, failed to pay child support & even wrote a letter denouncing his parental rights. Could Todd do more or just a bad rap?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Harv and Lynne say their son, Mark, is an adolescent living in a 41-year-old man’s body. Mark is currently homeless and living in his beat-up car held together with bungee cords and glue. But Mark explains that he is “car camping” and not homeless.
programme.sub-title: Our Son Is A 40-Year-Old Homeless Car Camper

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Megan's ex-boyfriend Andy is trying to replace her as their 5-year-old son's mother with his new fiancée, Caitlin. Megan says Andy lied to the judge, falsely painting her as unfit, unstable & a drug addict. Andy says Megan's tale of woe is a sob story.
programme.sub-title: The Fight Over A Little Boy: Who's Tellng The Truth? Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Susie says she's at the end of her rope raising her 4-yr-old granddaughter & says daughter Adriana, 20, neglects her duties to spend time boyfriend Matt. Adriana strongly denies. Matt says he's judged for past drug use. Don't miss this emotional Dr. Phil.
programme.sub-title: I'm Raising My Granddaughter Because I Think My Daughter Is Violent, Abusive & Neglectful

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Jenaye posted an emotional video online about uncovering her husband James's infidelity she never imagined it would go viral. Discovering James slept with his hairstylist on their fifth anniversary, Jenaye says divorce might be the best option.
programme.sub-title: My Husband's Cheating Went Viral Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany says her relationship with her son's dad, Erik, was destroyed by constant lies & empty promises; she cut him off completely. Erik admits he's lied to his ex-girlfriends. Same with Sheka, who stopped wedding plans. Will more women come forward?
programme.sub-title: Our Lying Ex-Boyfriend Is The Next Dirty John Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tina says her sons lived in a “house of horrors” with their biological father, Jeff, and his wife, Sandra, with reports to Child Protective Services that “fell on deaf ears.” Son Ian and Christa, also from the home, tell of horrific abuse they endured.
programme.sub-title: Adopted Twin, Beaten, Strangled, Starved And Locked In A Room: The Exclusive Interview

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are you newlyweds suffering Honeymoon Hangover? The Bahamas vacation is over, the dress is put away and couples realize they now have this to face: Married Life. Dr. Phil discovers how little couples know about each other before they walk down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Keirsten claims her boyfriend, Mike, has slammed her face into the car radio and repeatedly hit her in the head, giving her several black eyes and a bloody lip. Although Mike's been arrested twice for domestic battery, she loves him and he's a great dad.
programme.sub-title: Daughter's Boyfriend Has Been Arrested For Domestic Battery Twice But She Refuses To Leave Him

programme.title: Hunan, Die andere Welt von Avatar
programme.desc: Im Südwesten Chinas, im Herzen der Provinz Hunan, befindet sich der Zhangjiajie, einer der schönsten Parks der Welt. Mit seinen 3000 Gipfeln, die in den Himmel ragen, bietet er Landschaften, die atemberaubend, aber auch mysteriös sind.

programme.title: Geo-Reportage
programme.desc: Ihre Arbeit ist für sie mehr als ein Beruf, gehört zu den gefährlichsten der Welt und bringt doch nur wenig Geld ein. Dennoch möchte keiner etwas anderes machen - die Baumkletterer von Kalifornien.

programme.title: Geo-Reportage
programme.desc: Acht junge Briten leben als Einsiedler auf Bird Island: eineinhalb Jahre ohne schnelles Internet, ohne Arzt oder Bäcker, ganz auf sich gestellt.

programme.title: Geo-Reportage: Hamburg - Die Stadt der Schwäne
programme.desc: Hamburg ist geprägt von Elbe und Hafen, von Alster und ihren Alsterschwänen. Zum Schutz der Schwäne gibt es seit über 400 Jahren ein eigenes städtisches Amt: Den Schwanenvater von Hamburg.

programme.title: Genuss Weltweit
programme.desc: Auf Kreta ist der Olivenbaum allgegenwärtig. Doch es gibt einen anderen, uralten Baum auf der Insel, der zeitgleich Früchte und Blüten trägt und dessen Früchte – die Karuben, einzigartige Eigenschaften besitzen: der Johannisbrotbaum.
programme.sub-title: Kreta - Die süßen Früchte des Johannisbrotbaums

programme.title: Genuss Weltweit
programme.desc: Mate-Tee – das Nationalgetränk Argentiniens. Aber Mate ist nicht nur ein Getränk, es ist auch eine Pflanze. Ein Leben ohne Mate ist im Land der Gauchos unvorstellbar. 250 Millionen Kilogramm Mate-Tee werden jährlich allein in Argentinien hergestellt.

programme.title: Levison Wood: Mein Traum von Mittelamerika
programme.desc: Levison Wood startet in Mexiko und begegnet Ruinen, Hurrikans und Kartellgebieten.

programme.title: Levison Wood: Mein Traum von Mittelamerika
programme.desc: Levison durchquert gewaltgeplagte Regionen in Guatemala und Honduras bis nach Nicaragua.

programme.title: Levison Wood: Mein Traum von Mittelamerika

programme.title: Levison Wood: Mein Traum von Mittelamerika
programme.desc: In Panama bereitet sich Levison auf den Darien Gap vor und besucht Höhlen und indigene Dörfer.

programme.title: Grenzgänger – Entlang des Nullmeridians
programme.desc: Das Abenteuer startet auf dem Null-Meridian in Greenwich, führt nach Göteborg, Richtung Norwegen und zum Nordkap: Wilde Fjorde, Rafting in den eisigen Gewässern und die Überquerung des Sognefjord.

programme.title: Grenzgänger – Entlang des Nullmeridians
programme.desc: Diese Folge startet am berühmten Geirangerfjord in Norwegen. Das Abenteurer-Duo reist nach Trondheim, ins Herz Lapplands, ins Land der wilden Rentiere und schließlich zum legendären Nordkap!

programme.title: Grenzgänger – Entlang des Nullmeridians
programme.desc: Die Grenzgänger setzen ihre Reise in Afrika fort. Es geht nach Windhoek, durch Wüste und Links-Verkehr zum gigantischen Etosha-Nationalpark und schließlich in die „deutsche Stadt“ Swakopmund.

programme.title: Grenzgänger – Entlang des Nullmeridians
programme.desc: Die Grenzgänger stellen sich den letzten Hürden ihrer Reise. Einem wilden Rundflug, einem nächtlichen Sandsturm und einem Autobrand. Ob sie die Reise am Kap der guten Hoffnung zu Ende bringen können?

programme.title: Die Schweiz von oben – Vom Zauber der Alpenrepublik
programme.desc: Die Schweiz gibt sich klein und bescheiden, ist in Wirklichkeit aber ein bedeutender Motor fürs Geschäftsleben und die Idee der Freiheit. Die Schweiz ist ein 'Goliath', der als David...

programme.title: Aerial America – Amerika von oben: Hawaii
programme.desc: Kaum eine Inselgruppe ist so ursprünglich und so voller lebendiger Vielfalt – und dabei so reich an Geschichten, Mythen und dramatischen Erzählungen: Hawaii. Eine Kette von acht großen, grünen Inseln, die nahe am Äquator in weiten Pazifik liegt.

programme.title: Aerial America – Amerika von oben: Dakota
programme.desc: Eine Reise über die Geschwister-Staaten Nord- und Süd-Dakota: Zwei Staaten, die einst zu einem einzigen riesigen Gebiet gehörten, reich an natürlichen Monumenten und von Menschenhand geschaffenen Sehenswürdigkeiten.

programme.title: Aerial America – Amerika von oben: Nebraska
programme.desc: Einst war Nebraska Indianerland, doch mit Lewis und Clark, die 1804 dem Missouri auf ihrer Suche nach der Westpassage folgten, begann die Zeit der Siedler. Ihre Spuren sind heute noch sichtbar.

programme.title: Aerial America – Amerika von oben: Iowa
programme.desc: Iowa ist vor allem für seine Landwirtschaft bekannt. Betriebsame Bauernhöfe und ausgedehnte Felder und Weiden prägen die Landschaft. Aus der Vogelperspektive lässt sich aber noch einiges mehr entdecken.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Früchte des Sommers
programme.desc: Mit den langsam abnehmenden Temperaturen beginnt in Europa im August die Erntezeit. Überall wird nun erkennbar, was aus der Saat im Frühling geworden ist. In Mitteleuropa gehen die letzten heißen Tage ins Land. Das nutzen die Menschen für ihre Arbeit.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Herbstboten
programme.desc: Im September geht der Sommer langsam zur Neige. Die Kraft der Sonne lässt spürbar nach. Von der Lüneburger Heide über Sachsen, die Wälder in den Masuren und Südtirol bis in die südfranzösische Provence.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Altweibersommer
programme.desc: Im September ist der Herbst bereits deutlich zu spüren. Der Altweibersommer hält zwar tagsüber oft noch sommerliche Temperaturen bereit, nachts und morgens kann es allerdings schon bitterkalt sein.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Erntedank
programme.desc: In den letzten warmen Tagen leeren sich die Felder, und die Speisekammern füllen sich. Überall in Europa wird das Erntedankfest begangen, das am Ende der fruchtbaren Jahreszeit gefeiert wird.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Goldener Oktober
programme.desc: Wenn die Tage im Herbst deutlich kürzer werden und die Temperaturen allmählich sinken, tritt ein farbenprächtiges Naturschauspiel auf.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Novembernebel
programme.desc: Der November bringt nach den letzten schönen Wetterperioden im Oktober vor allem Sturm, Kälte und Nebel mit sich. Der Winter naht und Mensch und Natur haben allerhand zu tun.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Winterboten
programme.desc: Ende November kündigt sich der bevorstehende Winter mit langen, frostigen Nächten und immer kürzer werdenden Tagen an. In höheren Lagen liegt bereits der erste Schnee.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Erster Schnee
programme.desc: Der Herbst verlässt langsam die nördliche Erdhalbkugel. Die Tage werden immer kürzer, und die prächtigen Farben der Bäume sind endgültig verschwunden.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Winterstille
programme.desc: Das Jahr klingt langsam aus. Wie mit Zuckerguss überzogen zeigt sich Mitteleuropa Mitte Dezember. Nur noch wenige Stunden am Tag lässt sich die Sonne blicken.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Eiseskälte
programme.desc: Anfang Januar hat klirrende Kälte Mitteleuropa erfasst. Die Temperaturen liegen nun dauerhaft unter null Grad Celsius. An vielen Seen und Bächen formen sich bizarre Skulpturen aus Eis.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Winterhärte
programme.desc: Es ist Februar. Je länger der Winter in Mitteleuropa andauert, desto stärker bekommen die Menschen und Tiere seine unangenehmen Seiten zu spüren.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Frühlingsboten
programme.desc: Passend dazu kündigt sich bei den Tieren der „Pferdeflüsterin“ Marlena Boron im Naturreservat Popielno im polnischen Masuren die Geburt der Konik-Fohlen an.

programme.title: Meeresleuchten – Der Pharaonenhafen von El Quseir el Quadim
programme.desc: Das artenreichste Korallenriff des Roten Meeres hat die Hafeneinfahrt überwachsen und bietet Meeresbiologen die Möglichkeit, ein weitgehend unbekanntes Phänomen zu erforschen: Fluoreszenz. Doch das ist nicht das einzige Geheimnis von El Quseir el Quadim.

programme.title: Faszinierende Regionen: Madagaskar Teil 1 und 2
programme.desc: Der Film entführt uns in die faszinierende Inselwelt Madagaskars. Das Fischervolk der Vezo gilt als „Kinder des Meeres“ und noch heute ziehen viele Familien mit ihren traditionellen...

programme.title: Faszinierende Regionen: Antarktis / Hudson Bay Teil 1 und 2
programme.desc: Der Film portraitiert die ungeahnte Vielfalt des Lebens im antarktischen Sommer. Von der Insel Südgeorgien bis zum ewigen Eis des Festlandes zeigt der Film, dass eine der kältesten Regionen der Erde im Sommer ein Paradies für Tiere ist.

programme.title: Faszinierende Regionen: Wunderwelt Schweiz - Jura Teil 1 und 2
programme.desc: Die Jura Region in der Schweizer Romandie überrascht mit einer vielfältigen Naturlandschaft. Vom idyllischen Vallée de Joux im Süden bis zum bitterkalten Winter im kältesten Ort der Schweiz, La Brévine zeigt der Film die vielen Facetten dieser Region.

programme.title: Faszinierende Regionen: Madagaskar Teil 3 / Masai Mara
programme.desc: Vom zentralen Hochland Madagaskars mit seiner beeindruckenden Bergwelt, über die Kaffee- und Vanilleanbaugebiete im Nordosten geht die Reise zu den majestätischen uralten Baobabs, deren bizarre Wuchsform sie zum Wahrzeichen Madagaskars machte.

programme.title: Faszinierende Regionen: Wunderwelt Schweiz - Lago Maggiore / Tessin
programme.desc: Der Lago Maggiore im Schweizer Kanton Tessin ist eines der beliebtesten Urlaubsziele des Landes. Doch abseits touristischer Pfade findet sich rund um den See eine faszinierende Tierwelt.

programme.title: Faszinierende Regionen: Schwarzwald / Vogesen Teil 1 und 2
programme.desc: In stimmungsvollen Bildern portraitiert der Film die reiche Naturwelt des Schwarzwalds. Er zeigt, wie die verschiedenen Tiere durch das Jahr kommen und verdeutlicht in opulenten Landschaftsaufnahmen die ganz besondere Faszination des Schwarzwaldes.

programme.title: Baby Boom - Eine schöne Bescherung
programme.desc: J.C. Wiatt, genannt "Tiger Lady", ist Karrierefrau mit 16-Stunden-Tag und Yuppie-Freund. Als sie die Vormundschaft für ein 13 Monate altes Baby erbt, steht ihr Leben Kopf. Was wie eine Katastrophe beginnt, wird bald das Beste, was ihr passieren konnte.

programme.title: Zurück zu dir
programme.desc: Der einsame Bob Rueland (David Duchovny) wird von Grace Briggs verzaubert (Minnie Driver), die von Menschen umgeben ist, die sie bemuttern, darunter ihr irischer Großvater, der mit seinem italienischen Schwager ein Restaurant im Chicago führt.

programme.title: Die Duellisten
programme.desc: Keith Carradine und Harvey Keitel spielen die Hauptrollen in diesem dramatischen Film über zwei Offiziere in Napoleons Armee, die sich eine Reihe von Duellen liefern.

programme.title: Die Bullen von Dallas
programme.desc: Im auf dem Bestseller des Ex-Dallas-Cowboy Peter Gent beruhenden DIE BULLEN VON DALLAS spielt Nolte einen Routinier, der sich von der gewaltsamen Welt abwendet, in der er so lange gelebt hat. Das bringt ihn auf Kollisionskurs mit dem Management.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: Nach einem fast tödlichen Feuergefecht erinnert sich Marcus an seine Reise vom verwaisten Straßenkind aus der Bronx über den Drogenhandel bis zur Zusammenarbeit mit einem Ex-Betrüger (Terrence Howard), um ein erfolgreicher Rap-Künstler zu werden.

programme.title: Die Bullen von Dallas
programme.desc: Im auf dem Bestseller des Ex-Dallas-Cowboy Peter Gent beruhenden DIE BULLEN VON DALLAS spielt Nolte einen Routinier, der sich von der gewaltsamen Welt abwendet, in der er so lange gelebt hat. Das bringt ihn auf Kollisionskurs mit dem Management.

programme.title: Everybody'S Fine
programme.desc: Als Frank Goodes (DeNiro) Kinder ein Familienwiedersehen absagen, macht sich der frische Witwer auf die Reise quer durchs Land, um sich mit ihnen neu zu verbinden. Doch seine Überraschungsbesuche offenbaren ein Bild, das alles andere als perfekt ist.

programme.title: Marvins Töchter
programme.desc: Mit einer Starbesetzung, zu der Leonardo DiCaprio, Meryl Streep, Diane Keaton und Robert DeNiro gehören, erzählt der Film die lustige und aufrüttelnde Geschichte der Reise einer Familie, sich wiederzufinden.

programme.title: True Life: Ich bin das schwarze Schaf
programme.desc: Wie ist es, ein Außenseiter in der eigenen Familie zu sein? In dieser Folge von 'True Life' trefft ihr drei junge Leute, die ihre Individualität ausdrücken, was dafür sorgt, dass sie alles andere als der Stolz ihres Rudels sind.

programme.title: True Life: Ich bin glücklich damit, fett zu sein

programme.title: True Life: Ich war mal bei den Amischen
programme.desc: Was, wenn du dich zwischen einem Leben in der modernen Welt und deinen Eltern entscheiden müsstest? Amische, Mitglieder einer christlichen Bewegung, die Fernseher, Autos und das Internet verbietet, um Gott näher zu sein, müssen das.

programme.title: True Life: Ich bin süchtig nach Videospielen
programme.desc: Für Millionen von Amerikanern sind Videospiele ein Hobby, ein unterhaltsamer Zeitvertreib oder ein Mittel, um sich abzureagieren. Doch manche Gamer haben ein überwältigendes Bedürfnis, Tag und Nacht zu spielen, unabhängig von den Folgen.

programme.title: Awkward: Silvester
programme.desc: Jennas Pläne für ein ruhiges Silvester werden über den Haufen geworfen, und sie landet auf einer wilden Party bei Ally, bei der alle etwas Neues (oder jemand Neues) ausprobieren.

programme.title: Awkward: Willkommen in der Hölle

programme.title: Awkward: Fegefeuer der Eitelkeiten
programme.desc: Das alljährliche Oberstufenlagerfeuer droht zu explodieren, als Jenna und Tamara rausfinden, dass alle Mädchen von den Jungs im sogenannten "Telefonbuch" bewertet werden, und es daraufhin der ganzen Schule erzählen.

programme.title: Awkward: #Drama
programme.desc: Der Geschlechterkampf flammt wieder auf, denn die Jungs-Datenbank von Jenna und Tamara wird immer bekannter und enthüllt ein Geheimnis, das die Freundschaft der beiden Mädels bedroht.
